title: Jab Imam Aayenge
body:
Jab Imam Aayenge
Haal e gham sunaenge jab Imam aayenge
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhm Dil dikhaenge Jab Imam Ayenge
Mehfil e jamaaenge Jab Imam Ayenge
<<DIVIDER>>
Bamodar sajaenge Jab Imam Ayenge
Jashn Hum manaenge Jab Imam Ayenge
<<DIVIDER>>
Zakhm hai abhi taaza maqqa aur madeena ke
Sham o kufa karbobala hum bhula nahi sakte
<<DIVIDER>>
Az sakheefa taai dam ghair se nahi pohche
Jitne dukh uthae hai humne kalma goyo se
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek ek chukaenge.....x2
Jab Imam Ayenge
<<DIVIDER>>
Shak hai jinko allah ke adl aur adaalat par
Mansab e nubuwat par saiyada ki ismat par
<<DIVIDER>>
Murtuza ki ahmed se mukhtasir niyabat par
Jinko Shak hai bara par baarwey ki ghaibat par
<<DIVIDER>>
Sab hi maar khaenge....x2
Jab Imam Ayenge
<<DIVIDER>>
Naam par sahaba ke kaam kafiro jaise
Naam par sahaba ke kaam fasiqo jaise
<<DIVIDER>>
Naam par sahaba ke kaam munkiro jaise
Naam par sahaba ke kaam mushriqo jaise
<<DIVIDER>>
Sab hi muh churaenge...x2
Jab Imam Aenge
<<DIVIDER>>
Dawa e mohabbat jo subho shaam karte hai
Unke dushman o se bhi raao rasm rakhte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Khums bhi nahi dete gheebatei bhi karte hai
Momino se bhi dil me bughz o keena rakhte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kistarah nibhaenge...x2
Jab Imam Aenge
<<DIVIDER>>
Jhut bolne ko hum mashwala samajhte hai
Baat baat par bejaa'n maslehat barakhte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Aur munafiqat ko bhi maslehat hi kehte hai
Lahmo laab ka saamaa'n hum gharo me rakhte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kistarah chhupaenge....x2
Jab Imam Aenge
<<DIVIDER>>
Nemate shariyat ko bojh hi samajhte hai
Lahmo laab hi ko hum zindagi samajte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Saahebaan e zar ko bada aadmi samajhte hai
Tang dast momin ko bas yuhi samajhte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya maqaam paenge
Jab Imam Aenge
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye hamare mukro riya shatirana aiyari
Kya hamare saumo salaat aur yeh azadari
<<DIVIDER>>
Kitna hai khuloos in me kis kadar riyakari
Kya imaam ki khatir hum ne ki hai taiyari
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaise muh dikhaenge...x2
Jab Imam Aenge
<<DIVIDER>>
Al ajal jo kehte hai agae to kya hoga
Kya hai apni taiyari pesh hum karenge kya
<<DIVIDER>>
Sibt e jafar apna to kul yahi hai sarmaya
Humd o naat o soz o salaam aur manqabat nauha
<<DIVIDER>>
Ham yahi sunaenge...x2
Jab Imam Aenge
author: Sibte Jaffer Shaheed
